message.body:
Dear Jana Procházková,

Thank you—we appreciate Strojírna Hrvelec’s interest in a reliable, long-term partnership and understand that delivery needs careful planning.

Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). This recent easing supports a lower material allowance.
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). The reduction in processing input prices also supports revisiting the quotation.

We can offer faster payment or more delivery flexibility in exchange for the following unit prices:

A: EUR 25.42, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days.
B: EUR 25.50, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days.
F: EUR 25.34, payment 60 days net, lead time 42 days.

All other RFQ terms remain unchanged. Your quoted lead time is beyond what we can accommodate.

Which of these works best for your planning?

Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

rationale: Jana emphasizes a long-term relationship but quotes a lead time we cannot accept. A preserves their payment structure, B tests the price lever, and F offers delivery flexibility; two strong, recent input-cost claims give concrete reasons to reduce the price.
